Amagon.name: Amagon
Amagon.summary: Amagon is a Nintendo Entertainment System platform side-scroller developed by Aicom in 1988. It was subject to a high level of criticism, and never reached a high level of recognition among game critics.

Black Bass, The.name: The Black Bass
Black Bass, The.summary: The Black Bass is a fishing game designed for the Nintendo Entertainment System by HOT B games and released in 1988. Although not presented as a sequel, this game is the second in the Black Bass series-the first game being a Japan-exclusive.

Heavy Shreddin'.name: Heavy Shreddin'
Heavy Shreddin'.summary: Heavy Shreddin' is a Snowboarding game, developed by Imagineering Inc and published by Parker Bros., which was released in 1990.

Othello.name: Othello
Othello.summary: Othello is a conversion of the board game. It was developed by Kawada and published by HAL Laboratory for the Famicom Disk System in Japan.

Ren & Stimpy Show, The - Buckeroo$!.name: The Ren & Stimpy Show: Buckeroo$!
Ren & Stimpy Show, The - Buckeroo$!.summary:
Stimpy invents the Gametron 5000 Moneymaker which is the first video game machine in the world that rewards the player with money. Ren, who is always on the lookout to get rich, eagerly gets to playing with the video game system on the quest to earn big bucks.

In the game, you control Ren & Stimpy through various side scrolling levels which are based on different episodes of the cartoon show. Episodes the levels are based on are Space Madness,Out West, and Robin Hoek.

Virus.name: Dr. Mario
Virus.summary: Dr. Mario is a falling block tile-matching video game, in which Mario assumes the role of a doctor, dropping two-colored medical capsules into a medicine bottle representing the playing field. This area is populated by viruses of three colors: red, yellow, and blue. In a manner and style considered similar to Tetris, the player manipulates each capsule as it falls, moving it left or right and rotating it such that it is positioned alongside the viruses and any existing capsules. When four or more capsule halves or viruses of matching color are aligned in vertical or horizontal configurations, they are removed from play. The main objective is to complete levels, which is accomplished by eliminating all viruses from the playing field. A game over occurs if capsules fill up the playing field in a way that obstructs the bottle's narrow neck.

White Lion Densetsu - Pyramid no Kanata.name: Legend of the Ghost Lion
White Lion Densetsu - Pyramid no Kanata.summary:
Legend of the Ghost Lion is a role-playing game for the Nintendo Entertainment System. It follows Maria, a young girl who enters a strange world as she searches for her missing parents.

The game uses turn-based battles, but differs from many console RPGs by replacing a conventional party with summoned companions. Maria explores towns, dungeons, and overworld areas, collecting items and spirits to progress through the story.
